description: Unit tests for HpackEntryCollector class in HTTP/2 HPACK header decoding, including tests for clearing, indexed headers, literal headers, and dynamic table size updates.

classes.name: HpackEntryCollector
classes.description: Class responsible for collecting and validating HPACK header entries during decoding.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the collector to its initial state.

methods.name: set_header_type
methods.description: Sets the type of header being processed.

methods.name: set_index
methods.description: Sets the index value for the header.

methods.name: set_name
methods.description: Sets the name of the header.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets the value of the header.

methods.name: OnIndexedHeader
methods.description: Handles an indexed header entry.

methods.name: OnStartLiteralHeader
methods.description: Begins processing a literal header.

methods.name: OnNameStart
methods.description: Starts processing the header name.

methods.name: OnNameData
methods.description: Processes header name data.

methods.name: OnNameEnd
methods.description: Ends processing the header name.

methods.name: OnValueStart
methods.description: Starts processing the header value.

methods.name: OnValueData
methods.description: Processes header value data.

methods.name: OnValueEnd
methods.description: Ends processing the header value.

methods.name: OnDynamicTableSizeUpdate
methods.description: Handles a dynamic table size update.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the collector.

methods.name: IsClear
methods.description: Checks if the collector is in a clear state.

methods.name: IsComplete
methods.description: Checks if the header entry is complete.

methods.name: ValidateIndexedHeader
methods.description: Validates an indexed header.

methods.name: ValidateLiteralValueHeader
methods.description: Validates a literal header with value.

methods.name: ValidateLiteralNameValueHeader
methods.description: Validates a literal header with name and value.

methods.name: ValidateDynamicTableSizeUpdate
methods.description: Validates a dynamic table size update.
